reason: Expert provides a troubleshooting rule and successful workaround for optical transmission devices where traffic counters are zero despite normal light levels.

knowledge.summary: On older transmission units where the port is up and optical levels are normal but traffic counters remain at zero, disable and enable the port to restore traffic instead of replacing hardware or rebooting.
knowledge.author: Erkki Expert
knowledge.details: Applies to older transmission units. SFP replacement and unit reboot are unnecessary when this specific counter issue occurs.
